contract_note_zh: 候选门槛是试验前的可否决设计，不是实测成绩；三项试验均未获授权、未运行。
contract_note_en: Candidate gates are pre-trial refusal criteria, not measured results; none of the three pilots is authorised or running.

roles.accountable: 城市问题 owner / delegated urban problem owner
roles.responsible: 公共沟通审校与人工回复班组 / public-communication review and human-response shift
roles.consulted: 隐私、公共教育、无障碍与相关专业人员 / privacy, public-learning, accessibility, and relevant professionals
roles.informed: 问题提出者、场地管理者与公开档案接收者 / problem submitters, site managers, and public-archive recipients

pilot_contracts.permission_zh: 只使用经同意的问题摘要与公开资料；纸卡和人工入口始终可用。
pilot_contracts.permission_en: Use only consented problem summaries and public material; paper cards and a human entry remain available.
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_zh: 记录普通问题提交能否被理解、确认并获得具名人工回复；当前未测。
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_en: Record whether an ordinary submission is understood, confirmed, and receives a named human response; not yet measured.
pilot_contracts.appeal_zh: 问题提出者可要求更正、删除或由独立审校者复核。
pilot_contracts.appeal_en: The submitter may request correction, deletion, or independent review.
pilot_contracts.stop_zh: 身份泄露、紧急问题误归类、无人负责回复或提出者不能纠正即停止。
pilot_contracts.stop_en: Stop on identity disclosure, urgent misclassification, absent human ownership, or inability of the submitter to correct the record.

pilot_contracts.zh: 具身智能城市实验室试点契约
pilot_contracts.en: Embodied AI Urban Lab pilot contract

roles.accountable: 场地与设备安全最终责任人 / ultimately accountable site-and-equipment safety owner
roles.responsible: 现场运营、设备维护与人工接管班组 / site operation, equipment maintenance, and human-takeover shift
roles.consulted: 铁路、交通、消防、无障碍、保险与隐私专业人员 / railway, transport, fire, accessibility, insurance, and privacy professionals
roles.informed: 普通路径使用者、场地管理者与周边运营者 / ordinary-route users, site managers, and nearby operators

pilot_contracts.permission_zh: 封闭、低速、有人值守；设备、场地、保险、急停与恢复责任书面明确。
pilot_contracts.permission_en: Enclosed, low-speed, and staffed, with written equipment, site, insurance, emergency-stop, and recovery responsibility.
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_zh: 记录人工任务时间、空间占用、冲突、礼让和最弱使用者绕行；当前未测。
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_en: Record manual task time, occupied space, conflicts, yielding, and vulnerable-user detours; not yet measured.
pilot_contracts.appeal_zh: 任何受影响使用者可向现场人工窗口要求停止并登记事件。
pilot_contracts.appeal_en: Any affected user may request a stop and incident record at the staffed on-site desk.
pilot_contracts.stop_zh: 伤害、侵入普通路径、急停失效、弱势使用者被迫避让或身份影像留存即停止。
pilot_contracts.stop_en: Stop on injury, intrusion into the ordinary path, failed emergency stop, forced yielding by vulnerable users, or retained identifying imagery.

pilot_contracts.zh: AI 健康与老龄实验室试点契约
pilot_contracts.en: AI Health and Aging Lab pilot contract

roles.accountable: 服务目录与人工转接最终责任人 / ultimately accountable service-directory and human-handoff owner
roles.responsible: 社区或养老专业服务与场地值守班组 / community or aging-service professionals and site duty shift
roles.consulted: 无障碍、隐私、公共卫生、交通与法律专业人员 / accessibility, privacy, public-health, transport, and legal professionals
roles.informed: 老年使用者、照护者、服务机构与场地管理者 / older users, caregivers, service providers, and site managers

pilot_contracts.permission_zh: 不收病历，不做诊断或健康评分；纸质目录、静态地图和人工窗口可完成核心旅程。
pilot_contracts.permission_en: Collect no medical records and perform no diagnosis or health scoring; paper directories, static maps, and a human window complete the core journey.
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_zh: 记录找到正确人工入口的完成、用时、错误往返和求助次数；当前未测。
pilot_contracts.ordinary_baseline_en: Record completion, time, wrong return trips, and help requests when finding the correct human service; not yet measured.
pilot_contracts.appeal_zh: 使用者或照护者可要求人工复核、纠正目录并删除非必要记录。
pilot_contracts.appeal_en: A user or caregiver may request human review, directory correction, and deletion of unnecessary records.
pilot_contracts.stop_zh: 高风险错误指引、目录过期、索取不必要身份或人工窗口不可用即停止。
pilot_contracts.stop_en: Stop on high-risk wrong direction, outdated directory, unnecessary identity request, or unavailable human service.
